lessons.title: A Trip to Beijing
lessons.context: A short recount of a family trip to Beijing last summer.

paragraphs.pinyin: Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒ hé jiārén qù le Běijīng lǚyóu.
paragraphs.hanzi: 去年夏天，我和家人去了北京旅游。
paragraphs.en: Last summer, I went to Beijing with my family for a trip.

paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò fēijī qù, fēi le sān gè xiǎoshí.
paragraphs.hanzi: 我们坐飞机去，飞了三个小时。
paragraphs.en: We went by plane, and the flight took three hours.

paragraphs.pinyin: Dì yī tiān, wǒmen qù le Chángchéng. Nàlǐ rén hěn duō, dànshì fēngjǐng fēicháng měi.
paragraphs.hanzi: 第一天，我们去了长城。那里人很多，但是风景非常美。
paragraphs.en: On the first day, we visited the Great Wall. There were many people there, but the scenery was extremely beautiful.

paragraphs.pinyin: Dì èr tiān, tiānqì bú tài hǎo, xià le yìdiǎn yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen qù le bówùguǎn.
paragraphs.hanzi: 第二天，天气不太好，下了一点雨，所以我们去了博物馆。
paragraphs.en: On the second day, the weather wasn't great, it rained a little, so we went to a museum.

paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒmen hái chī le hěn duō hǎochī de Běijīng cài, bǐrú kǎoyā.
paragraphs.hanzi: 我们还吃了很多好吃的北京菜，比如烤鸭。
paragraphs.en: We also ate a lot of delicious Beijing food, such as roast duck.

paragraphs.pinyin: Zuìhòu yì tiān, wǒmen mǎi le hěn duō lǐwù, ránhòu zuò fēijī huí jiā.
paragraphs.hanzi: 最后一天，我们买了很多礼物，然后坐飞机回家。
paragraphs.en: On the last day, we bought a lot of gifts, then flew home.

paragraphs.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng hěn yǒuyìsi, wǒ hěn xǐhuan Běijīng.
paragraphs.hanzi: 这次旅行很有意思，我很喜欢北京。
paragraphs.en: This trip was very interesting, I really liked Beijing.

lessons.title: Weekend Plans
lessons.context: Xiao Li calls her friend Dawei to make plans for the weekend.

paragraphs.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ, Xiǎo Lì gěi tā de péngyou Dàwěi dǎ diànhuà.
paragraphs.hanzi: 星期五下午，小丽给她的朋友大伟打电话。
paragraphs.en: On Friday afternoon, Xiao Li called her friend Dawei.

paragraphs.pinyin: Tā wèn Dàwěi zhōumò yǒu méiyǒu kòng.
paragraphs.hanzi: 她问大伟周末有没有空。
paragraphs.en: She asked Dawei if he was free on the weekend.

paragraphs.pinyin: Dàwěi shuō xīngqīliù shàngwǔ yào gōngzuò, dànshì xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
paragraphs.hanzi: 大伟说星期六上午要工作，但是下午有空。
paragraphs.en: Dawei said he had to work Saturday morning, but was free in the afternoon.

paragraphs.pinyin: Xiǎo Lì jiànyì tāmen qù kàn diànyǐng, ránhòu yìqǐ chīfàn.
paragraphs.hanzi: 小丽建议他们去看电影，然后一起吃饭。
paragraphs.en: Xiao Li suggested they go see a movie, then eat together.

paragraphs.pinyin: Dàwěi juéde zhège zhǔyi hěn hǎo, tā hěn gāoxìng.
paragraphs.hanzi: 大伟觉得这个主意很好，他很高兴。
paragraphs.en: Dawei thought it was a great idea, he was happy.

paragraphs.pinyin: Tāmen yuē hǎo xiàwǔ sì diǎn zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu jiàn miàn.
paragraphs.hanzi: 他们约好下午四点在电影院门口见面。
paragraphs.en: They agreed to meet at the cinema entrance at 4pm.

paragraphs.pinyin: Xīngqīliù dào le, tiānqì hěn hǎo, tāmen dùguò le yí gè yúkuài de xiàwǔ.
paragraphs.hanzi: 星期六到了，天气很好，他们度过了一个愉快的下午。
paragraphs.en: Saturday came, the weather was nice, and they spent a pleasant afternoon.
